name: limadata-mcp
description: MCP server for Limadata API - enrich people/company data, search prospects, research companies in real-time
author: Moifek Maiza <Mouafak.Maiza@proton.me>

scripts.dxt:stage: rm -rf build/dxt && mkdir -p build/dxt && cp -r dist build/dxt/ && cp manifest.json package.json build/dxt/ && (cp icon.png build/dxt/ 2>/dev/null || true) && cd build/dxt && npm install --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dxt:pack: npm run build && npm run dxt:stage && mcpb pack build/dxt limadata-mcp.dxt
